title: A Group of Flamingos Is Called a Flamboyance
description: Flamingos have one of the best group names in nature, and their pink color comes from what they eat.

scenes.text: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance. Honestly, it fits.
scenes.subject: flamingo
scenes.say: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance. [laughs] Honestly, it fits.

scenes.text: But here is the surprise. Flamingos are not born pink. The chicks are gray and white.
scenes.subject: flamingo
scenes.say: [gasps] But here is the surprise. Flamingos are NOT born pink. The chicks are gray and white.

scenes.text: They turn pink from their food. Tiny shrimp and algae they eat contain natural pigments that color their feathers.
scenes.subject: flamingo
scenes.say: They turn pink from their food. Tiny shrimp and algae they eat contain natural pigments that color their feathers.

scenes.text: If a flamingo stops eating those foods, its feathers slowly fade to a paler color.
scenes.subject: flamingo
scenes.say: [sad] If a flamingo stops eating those foods, its feathers slowly fade to a paler color.

scenes.text: So the pinkest flamingo is simply the best fed. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: flamingo
scenes.say: [chuckles] So the pinkest flamingo is simply the best fed. Follow for more weird facts.
